6.
Today, the parties have filed a Compromise Application, wherein both the parties have entered into compromise on 2025:UHC:3860 the following terms:
"Parties have come to a compromise that the claimants/appellants will get a lump sum amount of Rs. 1,10,000/- (One Lakh Ten Thousands) in addition to the amount paid already.
This amount will be paid without any interest to the claimants/appellants within a period of 8 weeks from the date of issuance of the certified copy of the order.
